course_name: 單元操作與輸送現象(二)
outline: This course is a complementary to the Unit Operation I at which the student gained knowledge to fluid mechanics. The covered topics in this course are meant to deal with: compressible fluids, transportation and metering of fluid, and agitation and mixing of liquid.
schedule:
1st week: Introduction
2-4 week: Incompressible Flow
5-8 weeks: Compressible Fluids
9 week: Mid-Term Exam
10 week: Discussion
11-12 weeks: Flow Past Immersed Objects
13-14 weeks: Transportation and Metering of Fluid
15-16 weeks: Agitation and Mixing of Liquid
17 week: Final Exam
18 week: Discussion
assessment:
Homework and Quizzes:25%
Midterm Exam:35%
Final Exam:40%
